title: roc-docx semantic snapshot
description: What a reader understood of a .docx, reduced to the facts oracles and the package can compare. Every field is always present; a reader writes the empty value ("", 0, false, []) for what it does not know and leaves that key out of `keys`. Comparison covers only the keys both snapshots list in `keys`. Normalization: text compares exactly after CR LF and CR become LF; dates are ISO 8601 and compare as instants, a date without a zone being UTC; lengths are whole twips (1/1440 inch); order is significant in every list.

producer.description: The reader that made the snapshot and its version.

document.description: The document's path relative to the repository root.

keys.description: The keys this reader is authoritative for. A key names a field of an element of a collection, a run field of a block, or a property.

blocks.description: The body in reading order, including the paragraphs inside lists and block quotes. A paragraph whose text is empty and that anchors no note, comment or revision is not a block.

notes.description: Footnotes and endnotes in the order of their references.

comments.description: Comments in the order of their anchors' starts.

revisions.description: Tracked changes in the order they first occur in the body. A move's source is a deletion and its destination an insertion. A change that directly follows another of the same kind, author and date, with nothing between them in the paragraph, is part of it.

sections.description: The body's sections in order, a run of body content after the last section's end being a section of its own. A section that does not state its page size or margins has a portrait Letter page, 12240 by 15840 twips, with margins of 1440, as LibreOffice gives one.

level.description: A heading's outline level from 1, a list item's nesting depth from 1, otherwise 0.

list.description: A list item's list kind, otherwise empty.

text.description: The paragraph's current text: inserted text is included, deleted text, note references and comment content are not. A line break is LF and a tab is TAB. Empty for a table.

runs.description: The text split where direct formatting changes; formatting a paragraph or character style contributes is not run formatting. Concatenated, the runs' text is the block's text. Empty for a table.

rows.description: A table as a text grid: one list of cell texts per row, a cell's paragraphs joined by LF, a cell spanning columns followed by empty cells for the columns it covers, a cell covered by a vertical merge from the row above and a grid column a row skips before its first cell or after its last each an empty cell. Empty unless the block is a table.

text.description: The note's paragraphs joined by LF.
The comment's paragraphs joined by LF.

anchor.description: The current text the comment covers, paragraphs joined by LF; empty for a comment without a range.

thread.description: The index in `comments` of the comment that starts this one's thread; a comment that is not a reply has its own index.

text.description: The inserted, deleted or reformatted text, paragraphs joined by LF. A field in it contributes its result, not its code.

margin_top.description: The distance from the page's top edge to the body, which a header stands within; negative when the body may run into the header.

margin_bottom.description: The distance from the page's bottom edge to the body, which a footer stands within.

header.description: The default header's paragraphs joined by LF, or empty; a section without a default header has the previous section's. A field contributes its result.

footer.description: The default footer's paragraphs joined by LF, or empty.
